identity.description: Zoho Cliq: Zoho's team chat and collaboration product with channels, chats, bots, and developer platform, served from zoho.com/cliq.
identity.identity_notes: Vendor pages at zoho.com/cliq describe the product; the MCP and REST API docs are Cliq-specific.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code flow for server-based apps and implicit flow for client-based apps per the v3 OAuth page. Refresh via grant_type=refresh_token at the token URL. Self Client is offered as a client type in the API console.
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens are valid for 1 hour; use the stored refresh token to generate a new access token.
auth.scopes_notes: Scope format is service_name.scope_name.operation_type, with operation types CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE, ALL (example ZohoCliq.Bots.READ). Incoming webhook endpoint requires ZohoCliq.Webhooks.CREATE and ZohoCliq.BotMessages.CREATE. Full scope table not retrieved.

access.production_restrictions: No app-review gate found in sources reviewed; not established.

write_ops: Send message to chat, user, or channel
Send incoming webhook message to a bot
api.limitations: Rate limits not published on the v3 introduction page. Vendor does not classify tools as read or write. Developer-platform objects are capped per organization by plan (Free plan: 100 bots, 100 slash commands, 10 extensions).
